LESSON: NUMBER

Grade: PP2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: NUMBERS 2.1 Rote counting By the end of the sub-strand, • Demonstrate rote count
Topic 2.5: Number

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Number. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify numerals 1-20 for enhancement of acquisition of formation of number symbols
2. appreciate use of numbers and develop curiosity for numbers in daily life experiences. number recognition games such as (fishing game, domino games, skittle game, snake and ladder games, treasure hand, post office game). symbols, identify number numerals using ICT devices

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify numerals 1-20 for enhancement of acquisition of formation of number symbols
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify numerals 1-20 for enhancement of acquisition of formation of number symbols. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate use of numbers and develop curiosity for numbers in daily life experiences. number recognition games such as (fishing game, domino games, skittle game, snake and ladder games, treasure hand, post office game). symbols, identify number numerals using ICT devices
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate use of numbers and develop curiosity for numbers in daily life experiences. number recognition games such as (fishing game, domino games, skittle game, snake and ladder games, treasure hand, post office game). symbols, identify number numerals using ICT devices. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market in your county, count 10 mangoes. Put them in 2 groups of 5. That is sorting and grouping.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row. Write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and your parent gives you 5 more, you have 12 shillings. That is addition.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Number.
2. Explain Number to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Number.
4. Show that you can: identify numerals 1-20 for enhancement of acquisition of formation of number symbols
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Number. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Number important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify numerals 1-20 for enhancement of acquisition of formation of number symbols
2. appreciate use of numbers and develop curiosity for numbers in daily life experiences. number recognition games such as (fishing game, domino games, skittle game, snake and ladder games, treasure hand, post office game). symbols, identify number numerals using ICT devices

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
